streams.name: Install Tailliuir Network
streams.title: Install Tailliuir Network
streams.description: You need the Tailliuir Network addon installed — that's what actually connects you to the Tailliuir Studio. This addon on its own is just information.

streams.name: 📺 Not on a 4K device? 📺
streams.title: 📺 Not on a 4K device? 📺
streams.description: If your TV or device isn't 4K, don't use the 4K-tagged links — they won't work on your screen. Pick a lower quality link instead.

streams.name: 🚦Quality Traffic Lights🚦
streams.title: 🚦Quality Traffic Lights🚦
streams.description:
🟢 Green: best link, use first
🟠 Orange: okay, solid backup
🔴 Red: avoid, or last resort only. This only applies to the Tailliuir Network addon.

streams.name: ⚠️ Having issues? ⚠️
streams.title: ⚠️ Having issues? ⚠️
streams.description: Check status.torbox.app before assuming it's broken

streams.name: ☁️Backups & fallbacks☁️
streams.title: ☁️Backups & fallbacks☁️
streams.description: If TorBox is down, backup/fallback addons are available — find them on the full Tailliuir Studio website.
